description: Accommodations for students who are deaf, hard of hearing, or have auditory processing disorders
specific_accommodations: Sign language interpreter for all classes and university events
FM listening system or other assistive listening devices
Front-row seating with clear view of instructor
All audio materials provided with transcripts or captions
Visual fire alarms in classroom and residence
Written instructions for all oral announcements
documentation_required: Hearing loss diagnosis from audiologist or ENT
notes: Coordinate interpreter/captioning schedule at least 2 weeks before semester. Student should meet with instructors to discuss communication preferences.
